title: Salary: researching a range, and answering "what are your expectations"

videos.script: Sooner or later somebody asks: what are your salary expectations? In Brazil it is often a field on the application form, before anybody has spoken to you. {{field}} Most people starting out either guess, or say whatever you think is fair, which hands the decision to the other side. {{guess}} There is a better way, and it starts before the question: research a range, know what the number includes, and have one sentence ready. {{better}} This lesson does the research, does the arithmetic of CLT against PJ, and writes the sentence.
